description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants Max HP +2000 to party, grants [Master Mode], [Instant ATB 1] & Starry Mysidia Stars to user
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 1, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast 1
Starry Mysidia Stars: [Damage] or [Lightning Damage] +5% to party if user has/does not have Realm Synergy
Interval Chase: [10 single-target Prismatic/NE white magic attacks] or [Single-target minor DeShell for 5 seconds] & [Damage] or [Lightning Damage] +10/15/20/25/30% to party after 1/2/3/4/5 chases if user has/does not have Realm Synergy (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Prismatic/NE piercing white magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, [Instant Cast 1] to party & [200% ATB 1] to En-Lightning members, removes Master Mode

description.name: Master Mode
description.text: Instant cast speed and no cost for the first Soul Break cast, grants [Hero Boost] and sets the Hero Boost level to 1 when set

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: 200% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x2.00
